title: Find Missing Number
description: Given `N` and an array containing `N` distinct integers taken from `0, 1, 2, ..., N`, find and print the single missing number.
instructions: Line 2: `N` integers from `0..N` with one missing.
hints: Subtract the actual sum of the array from the expected sum.
That difference is the missing number in `O(N)` time and `O(1)` space!

arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
